'''''Star Wars: The Bounty Hunters''''' was a three-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The first issue was released in August of [[1999]]. The comic ''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]'' was also included in the TPB.
